name: TSURUWrapper unauthorized ERC1155 callback mint
summary: onERC1155Received returns early for the immutable trusted NFT contract but mints for every other caller. Three transfers of an unrelated ERC1155 first minted 1.2 million unbacked TSURU; a later caller minted another 167.2 million directly. Both actors sold the counterfeit tokens into the same WETH pool.
notes: Exact WETH transferred out of UniV3 pool 0x913b1658dd001dff93d3af2a657523f1eed53917 in three sales totals 141.259575571745388408. The first actor sold all 1.2 million counterfeit TSURU in two transactions; the later actor sold all 167.2 million in one. No WETH was supplied by either actor to these disposals. Counterfeit TSURU and unrelated NFTs are not counted as victim assets. Gas, router fees, and later recoveries do not reduce gross pool depletion. WETH valued at each disposal using timestamped ETH market prices; the seed $140,000 is replaced, not added.
